title: Block Roulette
description: Every few minutes, you must find a randomly selected block or lose permanent health! A challenging survival mod with timed block collection and smart block selection.
body:
# Slot Machine

A challenging survival mod that adds a timed block collection mechanic.

## How It Works

- Every 20 seconds (configurable), a random block from your surroundings is selected
- You must have that block in your inventory before time runs out
- **Win**: Get a random reward item OR restore lost health
- **Lose**: Lose 1 heart permanently + lightning strike effect

## Features

- **Smart Block Selection**: Scans 30-block radius and picks rarer blocks nearby
- **Permanent Health Loss**: Hearts lost persist through death (resets on game restart)
- **Visual Effects**: Lightning strikes and damage flash on failure
- **Compact HUD**: Shows target block and countdown timer in top-right corner
- **Health Restoration**: Win rounds to slowly restore lost hearts

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.1
2. Install Fabric API
3. Drop this mod in your mods folder

## Tips

- Keep common blocks in your inventory
- The mod picks blocks that exist near you, so explore diverse areas
- Winning restores half a heart if you have lost health
